generate_robust_regression_data: generate synthetic robust regression train and test datasets with configurable hyperparameters and seed
evaluate_posterior_predictive_likelihood: evaluate the posterior predictive log-likelihood of test items against posterior samples using Student-t distribution
create_robust_regression_model: create a RobustRegression model class that generates data with Normal priors and Student-t likelihood
review_robust_regression_generate_data: review the generate_data method to understand how synthetic X and Y data is generated with configurable parameters
summarize_robust_regression_class: summarize the RobustRegression class model including priors for alpha, beta, nu, and sigma parameters
